pedal: A pedal the user chose, unknown to the analysis — blind test (mono: the pedal's input -> its mono output)
note: The pedal off (its LED off): the reference. Interface out 3 into the pedal's input (the mono one if it has two), its mono output into front input 2. If it has a second output, leave it empty.

rig.note: Boss MYSTERY on its 9 V adapter: the guitar DI dataset. Input from interface out 3; OUTPUT -> input 2; INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise.
